steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$products = wc_get_products( [ 'limit' => 10, 'status' => 'publish' ] );
if ( empty( $products ) ) {
    return;
}

$usernames = [ 'frank_j', 'jack_m', 'katrin_r', 'emma_b', 'david_d', 'sophia_e' ];
$wp_roles  = wp_roles();

foreach ( $usernames as $username ) {
    $user = get_user_by( 'login', $username );
    if ( ! $user ) {
        continue;
    }

    $order = wc_create_order( [ 'customer_id' => $user->ID ] );

    $line_items_count = rand( 1, 3 );
    $chosen_products  = (array) array_rand( $products, min( $line_items_count, count( $products ) ) );
    foreach ( $chosen_products as $index ) {
        $order->add_product( $products[ $index ], rand( 15, 50 ) );
    }

    $address = [
        'first_name' => $user->first_name ?: $user->display_name,
        'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
        'email'      => $user->user_email,
    ];
    $order->set_address( $address, 'billing' );
    $order->set_address( $address, 'shipping' );

    $role_slug = $user->roles[0] ?? '';
    $role_name = $wp_roles->roles[ $role_slug ]['name'] ?? '';
    if ( $role_name ) {
        $order->update_meta_data( '_ywhs_wholesale_role', $role_name );
    }

    $order->calculate_totals();
    $order->set_status( 'completed' );
    $order->save();
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$page = get_page_by_path('become-a-wholesaler');
if (!$page) {
    return;
}

$menu_name = 'Primary Menu';
$menu = wp_get_nav_menu_object($menu_name);

if (!$menu) {
    $menu_id = wp_create_nav_menu($menu_name);
} else {
    $menu_id = $menu->term_id;
}

wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu_id, 0, [
    'menu-item-title'     => 'Become a Wholesaler',
    'menu-item-object'    => 'page',
    'menu-item-object-id' => $page->ID,
    'menu-item-type'      => 'post_type',
    'menu-item-status'    => 'publish',
]);

$locations = get_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations') ?: [];
$locations['primary'] = $menu_id;
$locations['primary-menu'] = $menu_id;
set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', $locations);
